data.raw_text:
Both aircraft were equipped with a TCAS, so why wasn’t an RA generated? 🚨

But first, let’s look at a few definitions.

AGL: Above Ground Level

TCAS: Traffic Collision Avoidance System

Traffic Advisory (TA): An indication given to the flight crew that a certain intruder is a potential threat.

Resolution Advisory (RA): The @icao defines all RAs as involving either “a manoeuvre intended to provide separation from all threats” or “a manoeuvre restriction intended to maintain existing separation.”

Below 1000’ AGL, the TCAS system switches to TA only mode and only provides “traffic advisories” hence no RAs are generated, no evasive command issued.

Had these airplanes been inflight and above 1000’ AGL, an RA would have been issued well in advance. 

One aircraft would have gotten a climb command 🛫 while the other a descend 🛬
